title: Bare account name bypasses bearer authentication
expected: Authenticate with the documented bearer token. Rule: app/README.md.
observed: Authorization containing only the account name returned 200 on payment and reduced balance from 10000 to 9000.
reproduction: Create Alice order with authorized fixture token, pay with bare account name, read saved wallet and order using valid authentication.
preconditions: Known account name and existing draft for demonstrated payment.
uncertainty: Local synthetic fixture only; no production exploitability claim.
impact: Impersonation through shared authentication helper; payment demonstrated, other authenticated routes share the same helper.
remediation: Reject missing bearer fixture prefix before extracting identity. Applied in app/app.py and successfully retested.
